body:
I decided to try this compound after a brief search on the net.
Here in Italy GABOB is sold regularely under the name of GAMIBETAL : white tablets of 500 mg each.
At first I decided to try 250 mgs and cut the tablet in half. Nothing happened. So I decided (after 1 and a half hour) to take a whole tablet. Nothing happened again but I felt a bit drowsy. I went to bed definetely disappointed.
